contract.interface:
For time-dependent Lindblad dynamics, the input supplies coherent controlled and inverse projected-unitary encodings of the stacked jump map Lstack(t)/g and H(t)/h0 at binary times, with ||Lstack(t)||<=g, ||H(t)||<=h0 and valid Lipschitz constants ell_L, ell_H. No commutation, gap or mixing promise is made. For one unknown input rho, including reference entanglement, define nu_rho=integral_0^T Tr[Lstack(t)^dagger Lstack(t) rho(t)]dt in this supplied jump representation; 0<=nu_rho<=g^2 T. The response proposes a channel with diamond error <=epsilon, expected queries O-tilde(1+g sqrt(T(1+nu_rho))+h0 T) without receiving/estimating nu_rho, and worst-case queries O-tilde(1+(g^2+h0)T). This is an adaptive execution guarantee, not an improved fixed-length worst-case bound or normalized rare-trajectory preparation.

For A_j=B_j^dagger B_j+iH_j, R_j=(I+A_j)^(-1), F_j=R_j...R_1 and F_0=I, the source derives the exact isometry V_n x=|survive> F_n x + sum_j |j,physical> sqrt(2)B_j F_j x + sum_j |j,defect> A_j F_j x, using I-R_j^dagger R_j=R_j^dagger(2B_j^dagger B_j+A_j^dagger A_j)R_j. The proposed known readout of physical and clock auxiliary sectors extracts V_n/64 from the prior clock resolvent, with winding Z close to I. Uniform singular values permit oblivious amplification with no survival penalty. Implementability and O-tilde(1+sqrt(n) beta+n gamma) query cost depend on the prior compiler, efficient clock arithmetic and imported interaction-picture/QSVT results, not on the conservation identity alone.

Time discretization uses A(t)=Lstack^dagger Lstack/2+iH, a=g^2/2+h0, D=a^2+g ell_L+ell_H, Delta=T/N and Kraus R_j=(I+Delta A(t_j))^(-1), sqrt(Delta)L_mu(t_j)R_j and Delta A(t_j)R_j. All outcomes are retained; the last is a numerical defect, not a physical jump. The source gives local recorded-instrument diamond error <=32D Delta^2, expected jump-count error <=64T Delta D(1+g^2T), and power-of-two N>=max{8(1+g^2T),2aT,1024T^2 D(1+g^2T)/epsilon}. Finer discretization preserves the normalized stacked oracle; N enters through logarithmic register/arithmetic/precision costs rather than N sequential calls, subject to the claimed compiler.

Phases use blocks T/2^r and allow 2^r new jumps before phase r+1. The claimed pathwise cost is O-tilde(1+k+g sqrt(T(k+1))+h0 T). Each first-event implementation has error <=epsilon/(1024N^2); at most N calls advance cells or stop. Jump-count control and Jensen yield the expected bound. After ceil(1+g^2T) jumps a general Lindblad simulator acts on the actual current state for the remaining interval. The fallback preserves the final-channel and worst-case guarantees, but does not output the complete future jump record. Omitting fallback retains the grid-resolved trajectory record and expected bound while losing the stated worst-case bound.

Consequences claimed: (1) the full first-failure isometry |pass>P_m...P_1 x + sum_j |j>(I-P_j)P_{j-1}...P_1 x in O-tilde(sqrt(m)) queries with coherent indexed reflections; it is not merely the pass block. A resolvent/geometric-label reduction is supplied, with a search lower bound. (2) Fixed event budget K gives O-tilde(K+1+g sqrt(T(K+1))+h0 T) worst-case queries including binned records; known grades 0,...,K, H grade-preserving and every jump lowering exactly one suffice. Tail overflow probability uniformly <=p gives final-channel error <=epsilon+2p.

Acquisition/cost boundary: arbitrary matrix lists or unrelated reflection circuits are not coherent selectors for free. From individual jump normalizations alpha_mu, stacked normalization g^2=sum alpha_mu^2 requires charged selection and amplitude preparation. Gate costs multiply query bounds by C_or(b)+poly(b,log d,log r), with b polynomial in parameter bit length, log N, log((1+tau)/epsilon), log(r+2). Oracle/arithmetic errors must support the finite hybrid budget; hidden factors cannot be powers of N, 1/epsilon, dimension or jump count. Adaptive circuit generation, final-state workspace and retained trajectory output are separately charged. Norm/Lipschitz/grade certificates are supplied promises, not automatically verified. The activity depends on the supplied jump representation. No experimental diamond-norm certification, generic dissipative fast-forwarding, inexpensive normalized no-jump state or rare postselection is established. The cited prior algorithms, inherited compiler and full implementation remain independent review obligations.
